$comment: Screenshot captions for Google Play and the App Store, framed by store/tools/compose-screenshots.mjs and checked by store/tools/check-listing.mjs (headline at most 30 characters, subline at most 70). Order is the store order: Play shows the first 8, the App Store the first 10. 'a' is the default set, 'b' the A/B alternative (store experiments, see store/GROWTH.md). 'raw' is the screenshot e2e/screenshots.sh takes (<lang>-<raw>.png); 'coverage' is drawn from the coverage numbers instead. Voice: the rider's worry first, the feature second.
